# Android delivery

`PULSE-debug.apk` is the verified installable debug build, copied from the actual Gradle output after tests and lint. It requires Android 9 / API 28 or newer. Health Connect availability depends on the device and provider; Demo Mode works independently.

This is a development build, not a Play Store release. See `SHA256SUMS.txt` for integrity and `../docs/POLISH_PASS_REPORT.md` for checks and limitations. The generated APK is ignored in Git but is present in this delivery workspace.
